svg.text: How big an LLM fits: Mac Studio memory tiers vs the largest open-weight models
Q4 quants need ~0.6 GB per B params; budget ~70-75% of unified memory for the model + KV cache (macOS keeps the rest)
36-48 GB (M5 Max base)
Fits: 27B dense Q8 (~27-30 GB), 35B MoE Q4 (~19-21 GB), 14B at Q8. Several small models resident at once.
Speeds: 8B Q4 75-110 tok/s, 14B 65-85 tok/s (MLX, single stream).
Best picks: Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma 4 26B-A4B.
64 GB (M5 Max)
Fits: 35B MoE at Q8 (~39 GB), 70B dense Q4 tight (~40 GB + KV), 32B dense Q8.
Speeds: Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B Q8 ~38 tok/s; 70B Q4 25-32 tok/s on 128 GB sibling.
Sweet spot for single-user coding agents that keep one large model warm all day.
128 GB (M5 Max max / M4 Max max)
Fits: 70B dense at Q4-Q8, 120B MoE (gpt-oss class), 284B MoE at IQ2 (DeepSeek V4 Flash, 1M ctx).
Speeds: 70B Q4 25-32 tok/s (M5 Max) vs 18-24 (M4 Max); gpt-oss-120B 14-19 tok/s.
~96 GB usable for models at the default 75% GPU memory limit (raise with iogpu.wired_limit_mb).
256 GB (M5 Ultra / legacy M3 Ultra)
Fits: Qwen3-235B-A22B Q4 (~120-135 GB), Llama 3.1 405B at Q3 (~195 GB), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B at Q8.
Speeds: 235B-A22B ~37 tok/s (est.); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 60-85 tok/s in agent loops (MacStories, 256 GB M5 Ultra).
405B dense at Q4 (~242 GB) is borderline - expect 8-12 tok/s class when it fits.
512 GB (M5 Ultra max, ships October 2026)
Fits: DeepSeek V3/R1 671B Q4 (370-405 GB, 17-20+ tok/s proven on M3 Ultra), Llama 4 Maverick 400B (~245 GB, ~12 tok/s), GLM 753B (est.).
The only consumer desk machine that runs frontier-class 400B-671B models entirely in memory.
Sources: Apple tech specs, Presenc AI benchmark table, ModelFit, LLMCheck, llamaperf, RunAIHome, MacStories - estimates marked, measured runs linked in the post.
